title: [Graal master] smallrye-config native integration test fails at runtime with MissingReflectionRegistrationError
body:

### Expected behavior

Native integration test passes

### Actual behavior

Native integration test fails

### How to Reproduce?

Reproducer:

1. Grab a GraalVM master build. E.g. from our [CI here](https://github.com/graalvm/mandrel/actions/runs/19913643705/artifacts/4758518961)
2. Build quarkus
3. Run `smallrye-config` native integration test

### Additional information

See the failure in our CI here: https://github.com/graalvm/mandrel/actions/runs/19913643705/job/57089878906#step:12:1372
